snippet.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros | Cinematic Reveal Trailer (Summer Game Fest)
snippet.description:
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros is a classic, premium real-time strategy game, coming to PC in 2026.

Take command of the Great Houses - or the Night King himself - as you raise your banners, rally iconic Heroes and conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in exciting free-for-all multiplayer.

Developed and Published by PlaySide Studios. Officially licensed by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment on behalf of HBO.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838950/Game_of_Thrones_War_For_Westeros/

Sign up to our newsletter for the latest updates: http://warforwesteros.com/
